why: The three shapes shift one place to the left each step (the first shape goes to the end): circle-triangle-square, triangle-square-circle, so C is square-circle-triangle. The cross moves clockwise round the corners: bottom-left, top-left, top-right, bottom-right. So C has the cross at top-right, which is option 2. Option 1 has the right shapes but the cross is in the wrong corner (top-left).
trick: Follow two things separately: the order of the shapes and the path of the small mark.
